items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (-0.3 points per decade; 1,651 surveys at 164 sites, 2006–2026; q = 0.43).
Paved and roofed area went from 3.2% in 1985 to 5.4% in 2025 across 1,774 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

402 of 1,774 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 33 for salt or chloride; 156 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
28 of 1,774 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 127 of 131 high-need ones have none.
Watershed traits do not reliably predict the sensitive share in this region (held-out R² 0.03, 164 sites).
